mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version,carrier_type, is_deleted, platform_channel_id, cn_name, en_name, code,service_platform, channel_status, supplier_name, supplier_code, shipment_method, logistics_platform, source_data, is_track, aging, origin_country, destination_country, overseas_warehouse_id, platform_warehouse_code
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(id) as id, MAX(cn_name) as cnName, MAX(platform_channel_id) as platformChannelId, code FROM logistics_sale_channel t WHERE t.is_deleted = false AND t.channel_status = 0 AND t.logistics_platform = #{platformType} AND t.service_platform ILIKE concat('%',#{servicePlatform}::text,'%') group by code

select id,cnName,platformChannelId,code from ( SELECT MAX(t.id) as id, MAX(t.cn_name) as cnName, MAX(t.platform_channel_id) as platformChannelId, t.code FROM logistics_sale_channel t WHERE t.is_deleted = false AND t.channel_status = 0
and t.cn_name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%')
AND t.logistics_platform = #{params.platformType}
AND t.service_platform ILIKE concat('%',#{params.servicePlatform}::text,'%')
group by t.code
order by case when t.cn_name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when t.cn_name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when t.cn_name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , t.cn_name,
) wls
